relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains SMS services status IE.
Condition where attempt counter is less than 5 starts timer T3411.
Condition where attempt counter is less than 5 establishes EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.
Condition where attempt counter is less than 5 establishes state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.
Condition where attempt counter equals 5 starts timer T3402.
Condition where attempt counter equals 5 establishes EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.
Condition where attempt counter equals 5 establishes state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.
Timer T3411 expiration triggers tracking area updating procedure.
Timer T3402 expiration triggers tracking area updating procedure.
Condition where attempt counter is less than 5 stops timer T3430 if running.
